text: DSH Time Machine（DSH 网页插件）：为 DSH 工作区自动创建检查点，并提供检查点时间线、差异查看和回滚。它接入 DSH 会话事件、工具服务、webServer 与网页侧栏界面，可在回合开始、审批或指定工具执行前保存影子 Git 快照，也可手动创建、列出、清理检查点，查看补丁或统计差异，并恢复整个工作区或单个文件。适合需要追溯 agent 文件改动并恢复工作区的 DSH 用户。需要本地 Git 才能执行基于提交的差异和回滚；插件不需要额外 API Key。

DSH Time Machine is a web plugin for workspace checkpoints, diffs, and rollback. It saves shadow Git snapshots around sessions and selected tool actions, and lets users browse history, compare changes, or restore a workspace or one file. Git is needed for diff and rollback; no API key is required.
想在 agent 修改文件前自动留一个可恢复的工作区检查点。
DSH 有没有办法查看两个工作区状态之间的文件差异？
我想把整个项目恢复到之前保存的状态。
只恢复某一个文件，不影响工作区里的其他改动该怎么做？
让 DSH 按会话保存并浏览最近的工作区检查点。
Can I compare a saved workspace checkpoint with the current files?
I need to restore one file from an earlier project state without rolling everything back.
DSH Time Machine 的功能「自动检查点」：插件监听 DSH 回合、审批和指定工具事件，在启用设置时为当前会话工作区创建检查点，并在成功回合后按保留数量清理旧记录。
DSH Time Machine 的功能「检查点时间线」：用户或 agent 可按会话列出检查点，也可创建、删除或清理较旧记录；插件通过 Git 影子引用保留提交信息。
DSH Time Machine 的功能「差异查看」：选择来源检查点后，可查看到当前工作区或另一个检查点的补丁差异，也可切换为文件统计摘要。
DSH Time Machine 的功能「工作区恢复」：用户确认后，可把 Git 工作区恢复到所选检查点；插件会尝试在操作前另存当前状态，便于之后找回。
DSH Time Machine 的功能「单文件恢复」：输入检查点和相对文件路径并确认后，可将指定文件恢复到该检查点版本，或移除该快照中不存在的文件。
DSH Time Machine 使用前须知：非 Git 工作区的检查点只保存在内存，不能用于回滚或 Git 差异查看（见 lib/snapshot.js:130-202、lib/snapshot.js:413-455）。
能不能在网页侧栏里查看检查点并挑选一个版本恢复？

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · ⚡ Overview：**`dsh-time-machine`** provides an automated safety net and instantaneous rollback engine for **DeepSeek Harness** workspaces.

Autonomous agents frequently execute complex multi-file refactorings, run mutating shell commands, or install dependencies. When an unexpected regression or broken state occurs, manual git reversion can be messy and risk losing untracked files or user git history.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · ⚡ Overview：`dsh-time-machine` creates lightweight **shadow git snapshots** in the background without modifying user git commits or branches, providing **1-click interactive rollback, visual file diffs, and automatic recovery prompts on command failure**.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 3. 🔍 Visual Snapshot Diff Inspector (`time_machine_diff`)：* Computes file-by-file visual diffs comparing current workspace state against any checkpoint;
* Highlights added, deleted, and modified lines with clean line numbers and statistics.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 4. 🕒 Interactive Sidebar & Settings Timeline (`lib/client.js`)：* Seamlessly integrates into DSH Web UI sidebar and settings tab;
* Displays a chronological timeline of session checkpoints with 1-click "Rollback", "Diff", and "Delete" buttons.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 5. 🩹 Auto-Heal on Command Failure：* Automatically records checkpoints when a tool or command fails, preserving recovery options.

---

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 4. Selective File Rollback & Staging Safety (v0.1.15)：- **Single File Restore**: Restore individual files corrupted by an agent without losing progress in other files via `time_machine_file_rollback` or Diff Modal UI.
- **Staging Safety Guard**: Preserves user uncommitted `git add` index (`stagedTreeHash`) across turns.
- **Pre-Tool Auto-Checkpoints**: Captures checkpoints automatically prior to high-risk tools (`bash`, `execute_command`, `apply_patch`).
- **Structured File Diff Navigation**: Monospace side-by-side file tree with line addition/deletion statistics.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 🛠️ Agent Tools Reference (7 Tools)：| Tool Name | Parameters | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `time_machine_checkpoint_create` | `label?: string, sessionId?: string` | Creates a shadow git workspace checkpoint before risky edits or operations |
| `time_machine_checkpoint_list` | `sessionId?: string` | Lists all recent workspace checkpoints newest first |
| `time_machine_checkpoint_rollback` | `id: string, confirm: boolean` | Safely reverts workspace files back to specified checkpoint without altering branch HEAD |
| `time_machine_diff` | `from: string, to?: string` | Returns unified file diff between current workspace and target checkpoint |
| `time_machine_checkpoint_delete` | `id: string, confirm: boolean` | Permanently deletes a single checkpoint and purges its git reference |
| `time_machine_checkpoint_prune` | `sessionId?: string, keep?: number` | Prunes session checkpoints, keeping only the newest N checkpoints |

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · 📦 Quick Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-time-machine
```

  autoSnapshotEnabled: true    # Automatically take checkpoints before file modifications
  maxSnapshots: 20             # Maximum rolling checkpoints retained in memory
  autoHealPrompt: true         # Prompt for rollback when a command fails

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · v0.1.16 — Security Hardening & Sidebar Tab Deduplication：* **Security (Gitea #38)**: Converted `isTrustedSettingsRequest` to a strict fail-closed model, verifying loopback IP (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`), `sec-fetch-site` (`same-origin`, `none`), request `origin` matching `host`, and bearer tokens. Enforced HTTP method restrictions across all REST routes: all 5 mutating endpoints (`/create`, `/delete`, `/prune`, `/rollback`, `/rollback-file`) strictly require `POST` and return `405 Method Not Allowed` otherwise, while read routes (`/snapshots`, `/diff`) strictly require `GET`.
* **Fixed (GitHub #2)**: Resolved sidebar duplicate registration exception (`tab kind "time-machine" is already registered`) in DSH >= 0.1.6-alpha.1 when both native `sidebarRightTabs` and `betterSidebar` are present. Unified tab registration under a single shared guard with native sidebar precedence and safe error suppression.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · v0.1.10 — Stability, Dynamic CWD, Unified Diff & Architecture Polish：* **Added in v0.1.10**: Dynamic / session-aware `cwd` resolution: TimeMachine tools and REST endpoints automatically locate the active session workspace or accept explicit target directory.
* **Added in v0.1.10**: Unified diff support (`format: "patch" | "stat"`) with size limits (up to 256KB) and clean truncation warnings.
* **Added in v0.1.10**: Async execution queue on Git mutation engine to completely eliminate lockfile collisions under concurrent agent operations.
* **Added in v0.1.10**: Single-batch Git ref querying using `git for-each-ref` replacing $O(N)$ sequential `git log` processes for instant snapshot listings.
* **Added in v0.1.10**: Redundant commit deduplication: auto-snapshots are safely skipped if the working tree has not changed.
* **Added in v0.1.10**: Startup cleanup of temporary `tm_index_*` staging files.
* **Changed in v0.1.10**: Settings UI card streamlined, directing snapshot inspection to the dedicated Time Machine sidebar tab.
* **Changed in v0.1.10**: Comprehensive error logging replacing silent exceptions.

@goodandready/dsh-time-machine README · v0.1.7 — Critical Safety, Staging Isolation & Native Event Bus：* **Changed in v0.1.7**: Safe workspace rollback via `read-tree` + `checkout-index` + `clean -fd`. Rolling back to a checkpoint never modifies branch `HEAD` or severs git commit history.
* **Changed in v0.1.7**: User staging area protection. Checkpoints now isolate git index creation through `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, preventing disruption of pre-staged files in `.git/index`.
* **Changed in v0.1.7**: Native DSH session event integration. Subscribed to `session/event` bus for automated checkpoints on `turn/start`, `approval/asked`, `turn/end`, and command errors.
* **Changed in v0.1.7**: Automatic Git ref cleanup on snapshot eviction to eliminate disk ref leaks.
* **Changed in v0.1.7**: Direct working directory diff computation when comparing checkpoints with uncommitted changes.
* **Changed in v0.1.7**: Strict compliance with DSH Plugin Authoring guidelines: form fields are enabled only when settings status is `ready`.
* **Added in v0.1.7**: WebServer request body size limit (1MB max payload) for DoS protection.
* **Added in v0.1.7**: Complete Chinese localization (`zh`) in frontend interf
